spans.text: ...Battle concludes. The enemy assault on the outpost is successfully repelled.
...Under the covering fire from the HOCs, the outpost soon settles down again. The Griffin T-Dolls begin inspecting the damage through the pervasive smoke and dust.
I didn't think we'd actually survive.
We were just taking a one-sided beating, it feels so surreal now.
The stuff that the Commander brought along is pretty powerful.
416, thanks to you, our coordination with the Commander was seamless.
Don't mention it. Rather, I wouldn't live up to the position of adjutant if I hadn't done that.
We can relax for now with them protecting the base.
So what do we do now? Can we get on with rescuing the ones at the other strongpoints?
Feeling restless again?
My friends are still waiting for help. Although... it might be too late now.
Don't worry. According to our sources, the enemy blockade beyond the perimeter shows no sign of waning, which means they're still alive for the time being.
Miss Kalin, is the extraction point completely secured?
Yep, thanks for repelling the enemies! While their attention was diverted, a lot of our T-Dolls have been repaired. They're now standing by in multiple defensive positions.
Moreover, the first transport squadron has arrived!
The withdraw is finally underway?
That's right, but right now the priority is to evacuate the wounded and non-combat personnel. You may have to stay behind for now and fight.
(Sighs) I wouldn't leave even if I could. 9A-91 is still waiting for me.
But now that reinforcements are here, we can go all out, right?
Miss 416, your squad is a special case and has an injured member. Would you like to evacuate first?
I'm staying.
Pardon?
You don't have to consider us for the evacuation, we have our own arrangements. Besides, saving more T-Dolls is also more guarantee for our safety.
Instead of trusting this bunch of idiots on the base...I'd rather put my experience to good use.
Hey, we heard that.
That was mean, but then again you're the adjutant, say what you want!
Thank you, 416. You've been immensely helpful.
More like, how did you even manage before this...?
The Commander's work will be over soon, you'll only have five more minutes to catch your breath, make the most of it.
Miss Kalin, may I join the fireteam?
Huh? Are you going, too?
Since the base is safe for the time being, I'd rather be where I'm needed.
After all, the T-Dolls out there are in grave danger, every bit of  help increases our chance of victory.
I'm going as well! I won't let a rookie look down on me!
Uh, I told you she's not a rookie. You, on the other hand, are fresh out of IOP's factory, aren't you...?
Count me in, too. I really want to see for myself what you're made of.
416, are you okay with leading these T-Dolls?
A bunch of headstrong simpletons...
I have no objection as long as they follow my orders.
Haha... In any case, we're the only ones here to help.
Welcome to Griffin's Expendables, 416!
...What kind of dumb name is that?
It's even lamer than "404"...
